import unittest

from ratelimit import SlidingWindowLimiter


class TestBasics(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_allows_up_to_the_limit_in_one_window(self):
        rl = SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=3, window_seconds=60)
        t = 1000.0
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("alice", now=t))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("alice", now=t + 1))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("alice", now=t + 2))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow("alice", now=t + 3))

    def test_keys_are_independent(self):
        rl = SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=1, window_seconds=60)
        t = 1000.0
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("alice", now=t))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("bob", now=t))
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow("alice", now=t + 1))

    def test_window_slides_rather_than_resets(self):
        rl = SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=2, window_seconds=10)
        t = 1000.0
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("k", now=t))        # expires at t+10
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("k", now=t + 6))    # expires at t+16
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow("k", now=t + 9))   # both still inside
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("k", now=t + 11))   # first expired, one slot free
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow("k", now=t + 12))  # t+6 and t+11 still inside


class TestEdgeCases(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_denied_request_does_not_consume_a_slot(self):
        rl = SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=1, window_seconds=10)
        t = 1000.0
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("k", now=t))
        for i in range(1, 9):
            self.assertFalse(rl.allow("k", now=t + i))
        # if denials consumed slots, the window would never clear
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("k", now=t + 10.001))

    def test_boundary_is_exclusive(self):
        """A request exactly window_seconds later is outside the window."""
        rl = SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=1, window_seconds=10)
        t = 1000.0
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("k", now=t))
        self.assertTrue(rl.allow("k", now=t + 10.0))

    def test_zero_limit_denies_everything(self):
        rl = SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=0, window_seconds=10)
        self.assertFalse(rl.allow("k", now=1000.0))

    def test_invalid_construction_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=-1, window_seconds=10)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=1, window_seconds=0)

    def test_memory_does_not_grow_with_expired_entries(self):
        """Expired timestamps must be pruned, or a long-lived limiter leaks."""
        rl = SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=5, window_seconds=1)
        t = 1000.0
        for i in range(500):
            rl.allow("k", now=t + i * 2)      # every request in its own window
        self.assertLessEqual(rl.pending("k", now=t + 999), 1)

    def test_pending_reports_current_window_occupancy(self):
        rl = SlidingWindowLimiter(limit=3, window_seconds=10)
        t = 1000.0
        self.assertEqual(rl.pending("k", now=t), 0)
        rl.allow("k", now=t)
        rl.allow("k", now=t + 1)
        self.assertEqual(rl.pending("k", now=t + 2), 2)
        self.assertEqual(rl.pending("k", now=t + 11.5), 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
